title: Lynchings of 1888
dek: Every lynching our 1888 sources report, of any victim, with the year’s other episodes from the same dossiers, on 1910 county lines and month by month, set beside every 1888 victim in the standard inventories (Beck and Tolnay’s 2022 inventory of twelve Southern states, Seguin and Rigby’s national inventory, and the Monroe Work Today map data, used under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0). Select a mark or a table row to compare our record with the inventory field by field. Drafts: no entry has had human review.
